verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out or no-training commitment is a fair privacy question for a SaaS scheduling platform, but the evidence pack contains no statement about whether Cal.com uses customer data for AI training or offers a way to opt out. The compliance certifications (GDPR, SOC 2, HIPAA) and the self-hostable Cal.diy fork are adjacent privacy features, not a documented control against AI training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
